consequence.statement: Any endpoint.tls.caOptional configuration present in ConsulCatalog or Nomad provider static configuration will be ignored in v3.
consequence.remediation: Remove the endpoint.tls.caOptional option from the ConsulCatalog and Nomad provider static configuration sections.

original.statement: The ConsulCatalog provider endpoint.tls.caOptional option and the Nomad provider endpoint.tls.caOptional option have been removed in v3.

decision.reason: The migration guide says `endpoint.tls.CAOptional` "has been removed in v3" for both the ConsulCatalog provider [ev-7482c113b845] and the Nomad provider [ev-6c38c9ee7078]. It tells operators to remove `endpoint.tls.caOptional` from the provider's static configuration. A removed key whose value is no longer honoured fits the setting-ignored kind, and the proposed remediation matches the guide's remediation. The evidence does not say whether a leftover key is silently dropped or causes an error, but either way the configured value stops being honoured.
